description: Per-role and per-agent overrides, layered over routing/capabilities.json: defaults <- roles.<role> <- agents.<login> <- the agent's gitignored model-profile.local.json (bin/fabric-model writes it). A layer is PER PROVIDER — `providers.openrouter` names the session and any class as OpenRouter ids; `providers.anthropic` names the session, what each tier alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) binds to, and the reviewer's pin — because the two launch paths speak different vocabularies. The flat `session`/`capabilities` are the OpenRouter form. `agents` is keyed by the Linux login — the agent — never by a directory name. Credentials are never here.

defaults.notes: The session model is the main agent's, per provider: DeepSeek V4 Pro on the broker — the top tier, so the main conversation runs on the strongest admissible broker model (the owner, 2026-09-19; Sonnet 5 until then) — and Opus 5.5 on plain claude (the owner, 2026-09-24; Opus 5 from 2026-09-15). Its effort is routed (routing/effort.json), because Opus 5.5 defaults to medium where Opus 5 defaulted to high (docs/live-checks/2026-09-23-opus-5-5.md). the capability classes come from routing/capabilities.json unless a layer overrides one.

architect-cto-01.notes: The architect's main conversation runs on Fable 5.1, the top tier, not the coding tier's model (the owner, 2026-09-24). Only the model moves: its effort is the session's, routing/effort.json's medium, as every class's is since 2026-09-25; its code-plan subagents run on the column's model, Opus 5.5, at the same level.

python-dev-03.notes: The Sonnet pilot (the owner, 2026-10-08): python-dev-03's session runs on Sonnet 5.5 while its code-high, code-plan and review classes stay on the column's models; its blind-review findings per work commit are compared with python-dev-01's and -02's on Opus (docs/live-checks/2026-10-08-python-dev-sonnet-pilot.md) before the role's default changes.
